summary: Cintas filed an 8-K updating its pending acquisition of UniFirst under a March 10, 2026 merger agreement. On October 2, 2026, both companies certified substantial compliance with the FTC's Second Request and signed a timing agreement barring closing before December 11, 2026 absent FTC closure. They also certified completion of Canada's Supplementary Information Request on September 29, 2026. Cintas still expects closing before calendar year-end 2026, subject to customary conditions. The two-step merger structure makes UniFirst a wholly owned Cintas subsidiary. Watch the FTC review timeline and any divestiture demands.
